strategyDefinition.universe: BTC-USDT-SWAP and ETH-USDT-SWAP replace stale equity GEX inputs
strategyDefinition.entryGate: new entries only while point-in-time GEX is fresh, positive, and prior close is between put/call walls
strategyDefinition.riskUse: GEX can only disable entries; it never increases exposure or leverage
strategyDefinition.grossCap: 50% of current equity at 1x exchange leverage
strategyDefinition.netCap: 10% absolute net notional of current equity at entry
strategyDefinition.inventoryExpiry: each old lot exits at the next candle open with taker fee and slippage

decision.rule: Positive validation/test/full/cost-stress medians, both BTC and ETH positive in test, zero liquidations, and <=2% worst test drawdown.
